instruction: Add slide numbers to all slides in the presentation and ensure they appear in the bottom-right corner.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding slide numbers to all slides. Evaluator checks if slides contain numeric text in bottom-right area (bottom 20%, right 50% of slide). Score is 1.0 if at least 80% of slides have numbers in correct position, 0.0 otherwise.

scoring_breakdown.1.00: At least 80% of slides have numeric text in bottom-right corner

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Detection logic uses 'shape.text.strip().isdigit()' which only matches purely numeric text - will miss slide numbers with formatting like 'Slide 1', '1/10', or numbers with any non-digit characters
CRITICAL: Getter only checks text shapes, not LibreOffice Impress slide number fields (Insert → Header/Footer → Slide number) - may miss properly inserted slide numbers entirely
Incomplete verification: Evaluator may fail to detect correctly-inserted slide numbers due to overly restrictive text pattern matching
Position detection may miss edge cases where shape's top-left anchor is outside threshold but visual content is in bottom-right
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change detection logic from 'isdigit()' to regex pattern that accepts common slide number formats: r'\d+' (contains at least one digit), or check for slide number field objects in python-pptx
Check for LibreOffice slide number fields in addition to text shapes - slide numbers inserted via Insert → Header/Footer use special field objects, not plain text
Consider checking shape center position or bounding box center instead of just top-left corner for more accurate position verification
Add explicit verification that python-pptx can detect LibreOffice slide number fields, or document that only manually-typed numbers will be detected
